item.title: 🚨 President Joseph Aoun: - Building nations is a shared responsibility and does not fall on one pers
item.description:
🚨
President Joseph Aoun:
- Building nations is a shared responsibility and does not fall on one person or party alone. Everyone must act within their position and role, while the national interest must remain a priority and above any personal interest for the country to move forward.
- We decided to pursue negotiations to avoid the devastation and tragedies caused by the war. True, they are neither easy nor quick, and there are obstacles and difficulties, but they remain far better than war.
- We agree on the same objectives: liberating the south, deploying the army up to the border, recovering the prisoners, enabling residents to return, and rebuilding. As it has become clear, these goals cannot be achieved through war. Therefore, there is no option but negotiations.
